name: daydream
description: Design tool for the web where real HTML/CSS is the grain: a canvas of viewports Codex can read, land into and rework through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: A canvas of real HTML/CSS viewports your agent lands into.
interface.longDescription: Daydream is a design tool for the web where real HTML/CSS is the grain. With this plugin, Codex reads the canvas, lands new viewports, reworks existing ones and builds them piece by piece as drafts — every landing judged by the format validator and the enabled plugins' gates, answered with measured findings. The host runs on your machine; nothing leaves it.
defaultPrompt: Land a three-column grid playground on my Daydream canvas
Transcribe this article's layout technique into my Daydream library
